environment: Windows, in-app browser, isolated loopback node, synthetic source-created conversation conflicts and one intentionally unreadable older browser copy

steps.action: Create the explicitly labelled synthetic older-browser fixture using its button, then open Settings / Privacy & data
steps.observed: Node and browser cleanup have separate review controls; the fixture contains no real user data
One visible conversation, three recovery branches, one migration backup, an unsent draft and zero original AI tasks are shown; two source identities are included internally

steps.action: Open confirmation, cancel with Enter, then reopen and confirm with Tab / Enter
steps.observed: Cancel keeps data and returns focus; confirmation completes source, replica, backup, search and order steps, with a focused node-only result

steps.action: Review the browser copy and cancel its confirmation
steps.observed: The unreadable synthetic copy remains; focus returns to the browser-clear button

steps.action: Confirm browser cleanup with Tab / Enter
steps.observed: The reviewed copy is cleared, success receives focus, and other tabs/profiles/remote devices remain explicitly unconfirmed

steps.action: Stop the node and inspect its synthetic stores
steps.observed: Visible history, recovery and draft are empty; the reviewed migration backup is absent; both replica conversation records retain erased markers

steps.action: Restart with the same directory, reload Settings and review again
steps.observed: Completed node progress survives; node conversation/recovery/backup/task counts are zero; browser copies are zero and its clear button is disabled

steps.action: Discard the browser review by keyboard
steps.observed: Focus returns to Review browser copies

steps.action: Open Ask Ryn after restart and explicitly import older browser history
steps.observed: No conversations or old draft appear; import reports zero confirmed and zero requiring recovery; no model is installed

issues_fixed: Review controls briefly disabling themselves left focus at the document; review scopes now receive focus when loading finishes
Discarding a review removed the focused control; focus now returns to the original review button
Node-result wording could appear to contradict a separately completed browser cleanup; it now directs users to the separate browser status

layout.scope: Desktop viewport only; not complete responsive or packaged-desktop acceptance

limits: Node fixtures are seeded synthetic causal source records; this run does not exercise pairing or remote erase acknowledgements
The browser fixture is intentionally unreadable; actual encrypted v1 preservation, write abort, concurrent writers, response-loss retry and memory fallback are automated IndexedDB tests
The final additional pre-encryption deletion check is covered by automated tests, not a browser-injected cryptographic failure
Not physical-device, cross-NAT, every browser profile, full export or every personal-data scope acceptance
cleanup: Temporary browser tab closed and both owned node processes stopped; isolated synthetic data directory retained
